description: This Java class provides utility functions for manipulating and converting measurement data, such as postal codes, weights, and dimensions, based on the store merchant's unit preferences.

classes.name: DataUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling measurement and postal code data transformations.

methods.name: trimPostalCode
methods.description: Removes all non-alphanumeric characters from the postal code.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Converts weight units between pounds and kilograms based on store preferences.

methods.name: getMeasure
methods.description: Converts measurement units between inches and centimeters based on store preferences.
